subject: line segment to edge of plot at one end

messages.author: a963405a0585f59a
messages.subject: line segment to edge of plot at one end
parts:
Hi, is there a way to draw a line that terminates at one end, and not
at the other? I tried to do it with geom_segment, but margins get put
in even if I set the limit of the scale, and have the segments end at
the limit (or beyond):

p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-0.05,1.05))
p <- p + geom_segment(data=thresholds
(y=0.5,yend=-0.05,x=thresh,xend=thresh,colour=condition))

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: line segment to edge of plot at one end

Set the position to Inf or -Inf.

Hadley
